title: Aspen Beach House Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutAspen Beach House ~ 299 Defuniak Street ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off now thru Summer 2026! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Aspen Beach House is a family friendly 5,176 sf home (2,794 interior sf) located in Grayton Beach. With 4 bedrooms/5 full baths, Aspen Beach House will sleep up to 12 guests and offers a 21’ x 9’ private heated pool (heating fee applies) and a 5-minute stroll to the beach and “downtown” Grayton. Carport parking for 1 vehicle. Driveway parking for 4 vehicles. Historic Grayton Beach is 30A’s original beach community, founded in the mid-1880’s, which has stayed true to its funky, eclectic vibe. With its designated Blue Wave beach, Grayton Beach has been listed in Dr. Steven Leatherman's (“Dr. Beach”) infamous Top 10 Beaches of America FOUR times since 1991 (#1 in 1994, #6 in 2016, #3 in 2019, #1 in 2020), thanks to its pristine coastline and untouched dunes. Aspen Beach House – and Grayton Beach itself - has so much to offer, you may never want to venture farther out along 30A! Ground Level: Full bath with walk-in shower located poolside. Second Level: Main living room, dining table for 10, bar seating for 5, bistro seating for 2, fully equipped kitchen, 1-bedroom, full bath, laundry room, 10’ ceilings, covered balconies, screened balcony dining for 6. #1 Bedroom has a Queen bed Full Bath with tub/shower. Third Level: 3 bedrooms, 3 full baths, den, wet bar with mini fridge, covered + screened balconies. #2 En-Suite (Master) King bedroom, tub, separate shower, covered balcony. #3 En-Suite Queen/Queen bedroom, tub, separate shower, double vanity. #4 Bunk bedroom (4 Twins) Full Bath with tub/shower Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 2 Roku TVs (No Local Cable), Located in 2nd FL Living Room & 3rd FL Den Distinctive Features Private heated pool (heating fee applies) Kitchenaide appliances Carpeted bedrooms Hardwood floors in common areas 10’ ceilings throughout 3/10th mile to beach Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Carport parking for 1 vehicle, driveway parking for 4 vehicles 2 King beds, 1 Queen bed, 2 Bunks/4 Twin beds 5 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, hair dryers, outdoor gas and charcoal grills w/ grill utensils, covered balconies, screened balconies, balcony furniture, open patio, patio furniture, outdoor shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, granite countertops, Kitchenaide appliances, fridge with door ice/water dispenser, Keurig, coffeemaker, microwave, toaster, blender, stackable washer/dryer. Area Features Downtown Grayton Beach (3/10th mile) TimpoocheeTrail (30A bike path) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
